description: Enumerate pairs of restriction enzymes whose ends can be ligated (enzyme_set "common" = 39 enzymes, 64 pairs; "rebase" = 754 enzymes, 27869 pairs; paged by max_pairs / offset with totalPairs and truncated), or - with enzyme_name (any of the 754 REBASE enzymes with a defined cut) - the enzymes of enzyme_set that one enzyme's end can be ligated to, itself included.

enzyme_name.description: Optional: restrict the result to pairs involving this enzyme (case-insensitive); omit or leave blank for every pair of enzyme_set.

enzyme_set.description: Table to list: "common" (default; the 39 common laboratory enzymes) or "rebase" (all 754 REBASE enzymes with a defined cut). Case-insensitive.

max_pairs.description: All-pairs listing only: maximum number of pairs returned (1-10000; default 1000, which holds the whole common set). Not allowed together with enzyme_name.

offset.description: All-pairs listing only: number of pairs to skip before the returned page (>= 0; default 0). Not allowed together with enzyme_name.

end2.description: enzyme2's own end, same convention as compatibleEnd; equal to it except for the 12 REBASE pairs that anneal only through the reverse complement (all GN against CN).

totalPairs.description: All-pairs listing only: number of compatible pairs in the whole enzyme_set (common 64, rebase 27869), independent of max_pairs / offset. Omitted for the enzyme_name form.

truncated.description: All-pairs listing only: true when more pairs follow the returned page (offset + pairs.length < totalPairs). Omitted for the enzyme_name form.

errors.message: Unknown enzyme: <name> (only when enzyme_name is given)
max_pairs must be between 1 and 10000; offset cannot be negative (all-pairs listing)
max_pairs and offset page the all-pairs listing; they cannot be combined with enzyme_name.
